Container.Name: llamaMan
Container.Overview:
A browser-based UI for launching, monitoring, and managing multiple llama.cpp server instances. Spawns llama-server as sibling Docker containers using official llama.cpp images. Includes an Ollama-compatible API proxy for use with Open WebUI.
Universal GPU support for NVIDIA, AMD (ROCm), Intel Arc, and CPU. Auto-detects GPU vendor at startup. Optional multi-node clustering with shared database.
For full documentation, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/llamaman/

Config.Name: Management UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the llamaMan management web UI

Config.Name: Proxy Port
Config.Description: Ollama-compatible API proxy port (for OpenWebUI integration)

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Directory containing GGUF model files

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent data directory (state, presets, users, settings)

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Directory for instance and download logs

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket — required for llamaMan to spawn llama-server containers

Config.Name: GPU Sysfs (AMD/Intel)
Config.Description: GPU monitoring via sysfs (AMD + Intel Arc). Safe on NVIDIA hosts — ignored when pynvml is available.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone. List of available TZs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

Config.Name: LLAMAMAN_NODE_NAME
Config.Description: **Required.** Unique, stable identity for this deployment. It is the partition key for instances, downloads, and per-node settings. Pick once and keep it — changing it later orphans stored state.

Config.Name: HOST_MODELS_DIR
Config.Description: Real host path to the models directory. llamaMan passes this to the Docker daemon when spawning sibling containers, so it must resolve on the host. **Must match the host path of the Models mount above** — if you change one, change both.

Config.Name: HOST_LOGS_DIR
Config.Description: Real host path to the logs directory. Same requirement as HOST_MODELS_DIR — must resolve on the Docker host. **Must match the host path of the Logs mount above.**

Config.Name: LLAMAMAN_MAX_MODELS
Config.Description: Maximum number of chat models the proxy keeps loaded simultaneously. 0 = disabled (no eviction, launches on demand).

Config.Name: LLAMAMAN_PROXY_PORT
Config.Description: Internal proxy port (must match the Proxy Port config above)

Config.Name: LLAMAMAN_IDLE_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Minutes of inactivity before proxy-managed instances are stopped. 0 = disabled.

Config.Name: HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for a llama-server container health check before timing out

Config.Name: MODEL_LOAD_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for a model to fully load before timing out

Config.Name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds before a proxied inference request times out

Config.Name: LLAMA_IMAGE
Config.Description: llama.cpp server image for spawned containers. Auto-detected from GPU vendor if unset. NVIDIA: ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-cuda AMD ROCm: ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-rocm Intel Arc: ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-sycl CPU: ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server

Config.Name: LLAMA_NETWORK
Config.Description: Docker network used by llamaMan and spawned containers

Config.Name: LLAMA_CONTAINER_PREFIX
Config.Description: Prefix for spawned llama-server container names

Config.Name: GPU_TYPE
Config.Description: Override GPU auto-detection. Values: cuda, rocm, intel. Leave blank to auto-detect.

Config.Name: LLAMA_GPU_DEVICES
Config.Description: Comma-separated GPU indices visible to all llama-server containers (e.g. 0,1,3). Leave blank to expose all GPUs.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA hosts only — set to 'all' (or a specific GPU UUID) to give the llamaMan container native VRAM monitoring (pynvml). Also requires '--runtime=nvidia' in Extra Parameters and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES below, plus the Unraid Nvidia-Driver plugin. Leave blank on AMD/Intel/CPU hosts — GPU stats then fall back to nvidia-smi/rocm-smi inside a running instance.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: NVIDIA hosts only — set to 'utility' for native VRAM monitoring. Pairs with NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and '--runtime=nvidia' in Extra Parameters. Leave blank on AMD/Intel/CPU hosts.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional MariaDB/MySQL connection string for database backend. Example: mysql+pymysql://llamaman:password@host:3306/llamaman. Leave blank for JSON file storage (default).

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Flask session secret. Required for multi-replica deployments. Leave blank for auto-generated per restart.

Config.Name: CLUSTER_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable multi-node clustering. Set to true when running multiple llamaMan deployments as one cluster. Requires shared DATABASE_URL and CLUSTER_SECRET.

Config.Name: CLUSTER_SECRET
Config.Description: Shared bearer token for node-to-node HTTP calls. Must be identical on every cluster node.

Config.Name: CLUSTER_ADVERTISE_URL
Config.Description: How peers reach this node (e.g. http://srv1:5000). A hostname/IP routable from other cluster hosts.
